# anyscale_iam_role_grant (Resource)

~> **Beta.** Role bindings are enabled per organization by Anyscale while customers migrate; contact [support@anyscale.com](mailto:support@anyscale.com) to enable them. Beta resources may change incompatibly; every breaking change is listed in the changelog. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#role-bindings-beta).

Grants one role to one user group or user on an organization, cloud or project. Access granted this way is not visible to `anyscale_cloud_access`; see the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md). A binding cannot be edited, so changing any argument replaces it. Don't manage one scope with both this resource and `anyscale role-binding policy apply`: a policy apply revokes this resource's bindings, and the next apply re-creates them. Requires an organization [converted to role bindings](../guides/rbac.md#organization-access-mode).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The role to grant (`rol_...`); look one up by name with the `anyscale_role` data source. Changing it replaces the binding, leaving the principal without the role in between unless the resource sets `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }`.

### Optional

- `cloud_id` (String) Grant the role on this cloud. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `organization_id` (String) Grant the role on the organization: the token's own, as returned by the `anyscale_organization` data source. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `project_id` (String) Grant the role on this project. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `user_group_id` (String) The user group that holds the role (`ug_...`). Groups synced from an identity provider are accepted. Specify exactly one of `user_group_id` or `user_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `user_id` (String) The user that holds the role (`usr_...`); look up an organization member by email with the `anyscale_organization_user` data source. Service accounts are users too (`usr_...`). Specify exactly one of `user_group_id` or `user_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the grant was made.
- `created_by` (String) The ID of the user who made the grant. Null when the API does not know.
- `id` (String) The role binding ID (`rb_...`).
- `origin` (String) How the grant was made, as the API records it, for example `imperative`. Null when the API does not know.
